This is an automated hermes-sweeper review. The requested setup is implemented and documented on current `main`.

- `website/docs/user-guide/messaging/index.md:9` states that one gateway connects to all configured platforms; `:134-142` documents `hermes gateway setup` for all messaging platforms.
- `website/docs/user-guide/messaging/index.md:541-555` explicitly describes a gateway running several adapters at once.
- `gateway/run.py:7019-7066` starts an adapter for each enabled configured platform.
- If separate agents are intended rather than one agent on several channels, `website/docs/user-guide/profiles.md:7-13` and `:151-183` document independent profiles and gateways.
- The cross-referenced documentation PR #29638 was closed unmerged, but the relevant current documentation already covers the requested configuration.
